------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Typefaces in the design tokens

The design tokens, @oods/tokens, include the DM Sans, Geist and Geist Mono
typefaces, and @oods/foundry carries them inside its runtime archive, under
packages/tokens. Their notices follow as @oods/tokens carries them, so the
dist/fonts paths they name are inside packages/tokens. The SIL Open Font
License, Version 1.1 covers those files; the Apache License covering the rest
of OODS Foundry does not apply to them.
